title: Listening cycles: explore locally, rate candidates in the cloud web app
description:
The human-in-the-loop music workflow (the cybernetic loop): the explorer and harmony checker run on a local machine (too heavy for the cloud); a person rates a few candidates per cycle in the web app from any device; the local runner reads the ratings back to calibrate and seed the next run.

Ties into the existing schema. A candidate IS a Score: a fork (Score.forkOf/forkRoot) of the incumbent that differs in one choice. Stars are ordinary Ratings (targetType score), so picks feed the same taste signal ratings.py reads. The only new models:
- ListeningCycle: incumbentScoreId, question, options [{letter, scoreId, audio FileRef}] (the incumbent is one lettered option, 'keep as it was'), status open|closed, owner writes, signed-in reads.
- CycleVerdict (identifier cycleId+judge, owner-only like Verdict): best letter or 'same', per-letter notes, overall note, savedAt. Rating can't express 'B beat C'; public Comments would break blindness.
Audio: a cached render of each candidate Score at files/cycles/<cycleId>/<letter>.m4a. Candidate scores must stay out of public tag leaderboards (tag 'candidate' / folder 'cycles/<id>'; check the tally Lambda). The page hides titles until the verdict is saved, then reveals which letter was which.

Flow: (1) local explore.py leaves finalists; 'cycle publish' creates the fork Scores, uploads audio and the ListeningCycle; (2) Listen page in the web app (cloud, or local via apricity serve); (3) 'cycle pull' reads Ratings + CycleVerdict back into renders/log.jsonl (with checker_agrees) and the explorer notebook, closes the cycle, and can promote the winner (the winning fork becomes the score's next version).

Interim UI: the Listening Room artifact until the web page ships.
right_now_summary: Listening cycles now work end to end, from local candidate publishing to cloud ratings and pullback.
